provenance.note: Procedural vertex-coloured stiff-leg derrick (W1-93 looping worker): static base, slewing mast and boom, hook, rope fall and concrete bucket as separately driven nodes.

assets.exception_why: Four independently moving parts (base, slewing frame, rope fall, bucket), one draw each; at most three stand in a park, each a long way from the next. Limits asserted by the recipe.
